pages.text: Believers pray during the day (time 2000–9000, roughly morning to early afternoon). Each one prays for $(l)only one owner per day$() and only counts after walking $(l)at least 8 blocks$() from their bed. Villagers boxed into tiny cells don't count.

Output uses n, the number of believers praying at $(l)all your altars combined$(). n is capped at 24. Each extra believer adds a little less than the last. More altars give more prayer spots, but the total still follows the same curve.

$(l)Rough numbers$(): open-air altar with 2 believers, about 5/day; prostylos with 7, about 18/day; peripteros plus prostylos, about 40/day.$(br2)$(l)Rain$() halves an open-air altar; roofed temples are unaffected. Favor stops rising at your cap.$(br2)Time skipped with /time or by sleeping doesn't count as prayer time.
